# IconButton

## Description
It runs one action drawn as a single glyph, and its tooltip is its accessible name.

`import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";`, source `src/ui/IconButton.tsx`, status `ready`.
Foundation: hand-rolled. Traps checked: trap/button-div, trap/role-button, trap/native-control, trap/button-icon-name, trap/icon-optical-size, trap/icon-optical-align, trap/control-height, trap/focus-ring-shape, trap/hover-beats-focus, trap/disabled-still-hovers, trap/touch-hover-flash, trap/hover-unguarded, trap/touch-tap-highlight.

### Foundation
Not applicable: hand-rolled — the circle, the .08 hover fill and the 14px glyph are measured from the running Cursor 3.27.22 (`docs/system/decisions.md`), and the glyphs are the app's own `src/icons.ts` paths.

## Examples
`<IconButton icon="close" title="Close the panel" />` — the panel's close control.

Real uses, 8 call sites (`rg -c "<IconButton" src/components` → `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx:7`, `src/components/ToolStrip.tsx:1`):
- `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx` — the composer pilot: the toolbar's attach (`soft`), stop and send (`inverted`), and each attachment chip's remove circle (`sm`).
- `src/components/ToolStrip.tsx:80` — every tool in the strip: the glyph from the tool's icon id, the title its label and shortcut, click to invoke it.

## Variants

### variant
- `ghost`: the transparent circle for a tool bar; the default. Used at 5 call sites (an attachment chip's remove, the turn's copy, a tool's code copy, a reply's code copy, and every tool in the tool strip).
- `soft`: the resting `.08` fill, for a tool that is currently on. Used at 1 call site (the composer's attach).
- `inverted`: the ink-coloured circle with the accent-surface glyph, for the one primary action. Used at 2 call sites (the composer's stop and send).

Example: The transparent circle with the .08 hover fill. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/variant-ghost.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function VariantGhost() {
  return <IconButton icon="attach" title="Attach files" variant="ghost" />;
}
```

Example: The resting .08 fill, for a tool that is on. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/variant-soft.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function VariantSoft() {
  return <IconButton icon="list" title="List view" variant="soft" selected />;
}
```

Example: The white circle: the composer's send. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/variant-inverted.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function VariantInverted() {
  return <IconButton icon="send" title="Send" variant="inverted" />;
}
```

### size
- `sm`: the 20px circle with the 12px glyph, for a chip row. Used at 4 call sites (an attachment chip's remove, the turn's copy, a tool's code copy, a reply's code copy).
- `md`: the 24px circle with the 14px glyph, the composer's size. Used at 4 call sites (the composer's attach, stop and send, and every tool in the tool strip).

Example: The 20px circle with the 12px glyph. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/size-sm.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function SizeSm() {
  return <IconButton icon="close" title="Close" size="sm" />;
}
```

Example: The 24px circle with the 14px glyph. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/size-md.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function SizeMd() {
  return <IconButton icon="close" title="Close" size="md" />;
}
```

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rest | Nothing is over the circle. | Click it, or Tab to it. | The variant's resting fill, or none on `ghost`. | by hand |
| Hover | The pointer is over the circle, on a device with a hover pointer. | Click it. | The fill steps up one rung; the cursor is a pointer. | by hand |
| Pressed | The pointer is held down. | Release to run the action. | The next fill rung up. | by hand |
| Focused | Keyboard focus arrives by Tab. | Enter or Space runs the action. | The 1px accent ring at offset -1, following the circle. | by hand |
| Selected | The caller passes `selected` (a toggle). | Click it again to turn the tool off. | The `.14` fill, the full ink, and `aria-pressed="true"`. | test |
| Disabled | The caller's condition is false. | Nothing: no click, no hover. | The glyph drops to the disabled ink; the fill to the disabled step. | test |

Example: A blocked tool at the disabled ink. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/disabled.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function Disabled() {
  return <IconButton icon="stop" title="Stop" disabled />;
}
```

Example: A toggled tool at the .14 fill, announced pressed. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/selected.tsx`)

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "../../../../src/ui/IconButton";

export default function Selected() {
  return <IconButton icon="list" title="List view" selected />;
}
```

### State precedence
- Hover and Focused: Focused wins. The ring stays drawn while the pointer is over the circle; hover only steps the fill.
- Hover and Disabled: Disabled wins. A disabled circle keeps its resting look under the pointer and takes no click.
- Selected and Hover: both show. The `.14` selected fill stays; hover adds the pointer cursor and takes the fill to the pressed rung on press.
- Selected and Disabled: Disabled wins. A disabled toggle drops to the disabled ink and takes no click.
- Pressed and Focused: both show. The ring stays drawn while the circle is held down.

### Motion
| Trigger | Kind | Preset | Properties | Reduced motion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The pointer enters or leaves | input | hover / focus feedback (`--dur-fast` + `--ease-out`) | background-color, color | The fill and the ink change at once: the shell's `:root[data-animations="off"] *` rule removes the transition. |
| The pointer presses down | input | press (`--dur-instant` + `--ease-out`) | background-color | The fill changes at once. |

## Props

<!-- Props generated from src/ui/IconButton.tsx with TypeScript by scripts/props-table.mjs -->
| Prop | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `string` |  | The id from `../icons.ts`; the glyph is drawn in code. |
| `title` | `string` |  | The accessible name (also `aria-label`), and the tooltip. |
| `disabled?` | `boolean` |  | Blocks the click and drops the glyph to the disabled ink. |
| `onClick?` | `((event: MouseEvent) => void)` |  | Runs on click. |
| `selected?` | `boolean` |  | A toggle-style icon button: sets `aria-pressed` and the .14 selected fill. |
| `size?` | `IconButtonSize` |  | The box size. |
| `variant?` | `IconButtonVariant` |  | The look. |

- `icon`: the id from `src/icons.ts`; the glyph is drawn in code, never an image.
- `title`: the accessible name and the tooltip; an icon alone has no name without it.
- `variant`: the look; defaults to `ghost`.
- `size`: the circle; `md` is 24px with a 14px glyph, `sm` is 20px with a 12px glyph.
- `selected`: sets `aria-pressed` and the `.14` selected fill.
- `disabled`: blocks the click and drops the glyph to the disabled ink.
- `onClick`: runs on click; a disabled circle never fires it.

## Usage

### When to use
- The action is one glyph a tooltip can name: close, attach, send, stop, add.
- The control sits in a tool bar, a panel header or a toolbar row where a label would crowd the row.

### When not to use
- The action needs a label to be understood. Use `Button` instead.
- The control is a list item with a name. Use `Row` instead.
- The glyph is a status rather than an action. Use `Chip` instead.

### Rules
- `rule/icon-button-name`: When an icon button is rendered, pass `title` for every use, because the glyph alone leaves the accessible name empty and a screen reader announces "button". Evidence: app 3/3 composer icon buttons, `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx`. Check: test `src/ui/IconButton.test.tsx`.
  - Don't: `<IconButton icon="close" />` — no name.
  - Do: `<IconButton icon="close" title="Close the panel" />`
- `rule/icon-button-one-inverted`: When a toolbar row holds icon buttons, keep at most 1 `inverted` circle, because the ink-coloured circle is the row's primary action and a second one splits the eye. Evidence: measured 1 inverted send button in the composer toolbar, `docs/system/decisions.md`. Check: review `src/ui/ui.css`.
  - Don't: two `variant="inverted"` circles in the composer row.
  - Do: 1 `inverted` send and `ghost` for attach and stop.

### Content
- `rule/icon-button-title-sentence`: When `title` is written, name the action in sentence case with no full stop (Close the panel, Send, Stop), because the same string is the tooltip and the accessible name. Evidence: single use `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx:496`, the "Attach a picture (or paste, or drop one)" label. Check: review `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx`.
  - Don't: `title="close panel."`
  - Do: `title="Close the panel"`

### Anti-slop
- `rule/icon-button-canonical-element`: When a surface needs an icon action, render `IconButton` rather than a raw `<button>` with a hand-sized glyph, because the replaced classes hard-code 3 different box sizes and their own hover opacities. Evidence: app 10/10 lines across `src/assistant.css` and `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx`, `rg -c "assistant-icon|assistant-attachment-x" src`. Check: review `src/ui/IconButton.tsx`.
  - Don't: `<button class="assistant-icon" onClick={stop}>…</button>`
  - Do: `<IconButton icon="stop" title="Stop" onClick={stop} />`

### Limits
- `rule/icon-button-row-limit`: When a toolbar row holds more than 5 icon buttons, move the rest into a menu, because the measured composer row holds 3 at 24px each with 4px gaps and the row starts crowding the input past 5. Evidence: measured 3 actions at 24px with 4px gaps, `docs/system/decisions.md`. Check: review `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx`.
  - Don't: 6 circles in the composer's toolbar row.
  - Do: 3 circles in the row and the rest inside a menu.

## Accessibility
Rests on the native `<button>` element, with the drawn glyph hidden from assistive tech.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tab | The circle, in document order. | Moves focus to it; the accent ring draws. | On the circle. | by hand |
| Enter | The focused circle. | Runs the action. | Stays on the circle. | test |
| Space | The focused circle. | Runs the action on release, exactly once. | Stays on the circle. | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The circle | `button` (native) | `aria-label` (the same string as `title`) | `aria-pressed` when `selected`; `disabled` when blocked | "Close the panel, button" / "Stop, pressed button" | test |
| The glyph | `svg` with `aria-hidden="true"` | — | Hidden from the accessibility tree | Nothing: the name is the button's | test |
